cases.goal: At the camp, plan and start one permitted new building, then try to start another.
Arrange for two separately identified new-building requests to compete for the remaining place; if both are deferred, choose whether to submit a later attempt.
Start a building, pause and resume it, then complete it.
Start a building and cancel before work begins, then try a replacement.
Request an expansion and inspect the decision.
Request an expansion, review the offered terms, accept them and attempt another building.
Ask the available claimant for permission and inspect the outcome.
After accepting an expansion, retry the original request, reload, and try it across a restored boundary.
Start work on a new building, cancel the project, and try another building.
Ask about a further expansion after a previous expansion and inspect the response.
